name: workshop
description: Create the Workshop, Story, and Discussion frame for each chapter from the epic and chapter plan.

name: research
description: Deepen and verify era, place, figures, events, and source grounding for each chapter.

name: seeds
description: Curate chapter seed structure, included characters, and quality parameters.

name: correctness
description: Check factual claims, names, dates, terms, and uncertainty markers.

name: theme
description: Assign the theme spine, theme essence, and stereotype selection for each chapter.

name: syntax
description: Apply syntax guidance so the prose stays elevated, readable, and form-consistent.

name: override
description: Apply human-authored override instructions across every chapter model and draft.

name: quality
description: Run the final quality gate before finished chapters are assembled or promoted.
